title: Agent badges (experiments.agentBadges with its running beam): an agent in a background tab runs, asks for approval, then finishes; its tab's count pill and its row's status pill change in place

fake.description: A stand-in release agent: gate: waits on a FIFO, ask: asks permission (Agent badges tour)

steps.title: A quiet workspace, so an idle row shows beside the agent's
A gate the agent's first turn waits on
The agent starts: its turn runs until the gate opens
A terminal tab in front, so the agent works in the background
Queue the agent's next step: it will ask to deploy
Running: the row's Running pill and the beam on its edge; the tab's count slot is reserved and empty
The first turn ends and the ask begins
Needs approval: the row's pill turns to Needs approval and the beam stops; the tab's count appears, nothing moves
The agent reports back
cmux: Deployed to staging. Every check passed.

steps.title: Done: the row's Done pill; the tab's count stays until the chat is read, nothing moves
